exercises.name: 1. Jump Rope
exercises.notes: Easy pulse raiser. Stay relaxed through shoulders and bounce lightly.

exercises.name: 2. Dynamic Mobility Circuit
exercises.notes: World's greatest stretch, hip openers, ankle rocks, T-spine rotations. Move smoothly.

exercises.name: 3. Countermovement Jump
exercises.notes: Explode up fast, land softly, reset between reps.

exercises.name: 4. Push-Up
exercises.notes: Leave 2 reps in reserve. Straight line from head to heel.

exercises.name: 5. Bulgarian Split Squat
exercises.notes: Use bodyweight or hold household load if available. Control down, drive up.

exercises.name: 6. 1-Arm Backpack Row
exercises.notes: Use a loaded backpack or similar. Pull elbow toward hip, avoid twisting.

exercises.name: 7. Backpack Romanian Deadlift
exercises.notes: Soft knees, hinge at hips, keep back flat, feel hamstrings.

exercises.name: 8. Weighted Sit-Up
exercises.notes: Hold a light backpack or object if possible. Smooth reps, do not yank neck.

exercises.name: 9. Front Plank
exercises.notes: Brace hard, ribs down, squeeze glutes.

exercises.name: 10. Zone 2 Shadowboxing or Brisk Walk
exercises.notes: Steady conversational pace. Keep it easy to support recovery and aerobic base.

exercises.name: 1. Jump Rope
exercises.notes: Easy pulse raiser. Stay relaxed through shoulders and bounce lightly.

exercises.name: 2. Dynamic Mobility Circuit
exercises.notes: World's greatest stretch, hip openers, ankle rocks, T-spine rotations. Move smoothly.

exercises.name: 3. Broad Jump
exercises.notes: Jump far with good mechanics. Stick the landing softly.

exercises.name: 4. Push-Up
exercises.notes: Add 1 set from last week if all sets stayed clean with 2 reps in reserve.

exercises.name: 5. Bulgarian Split Squat
exercises.notes: Use bodyweight or household load. Keep torso tall and knee tracking over toes.

exercises.name: 6. 1-Arm Backpack Row
exercises.notes: Squeeze at the top. Use a slightly heavier backpack if available.

exercises.name: 7. Backpack Romanian Deadlift
exercises.notes: Controlled lowering, strong hip hinge, keep load close.

exercises.name: 8. Weighted Sit-Up
exercises.notes: Increase load slightly if all reps are easy.

exercises.name: 9. Side Plank
exercises.notes: Stack ribs and hips. Stay long through the body.

exercises.name: 10. Zone 2 Shadowboxing or Brisk Walk
exercises.notes: Steady easy pace. Nasal breathing if possible.

exercises.name: 1. Jump Rope
exercises.notes: Easy pulse raiser. Stay relaxed through shoulders and bounce lightly.

exercises.name: 2. Dynamic Mobility Circuit
exercises.notes: World's greatest stretch, hip openers, ankle rocks, T-spine rotations. Move smoothly.

exercises.name: 3. Skater Jump
exercises.notes: Cover distance with control. Stick each landing before the next rep.

exercises.name: 4. Feet-Elevated Push-Up or Standard Push-Up
exercises.notes: Choose the harder option only if form stays solid. Leave 1–2 reps in reserve.

exercises.name: 5. Bulgarian Split Squat
exercises.notes: Use slightly more load if possible. Control down for 2 seconds.

exercises.name: 6. 1-Arm Backpack Row
exercises.notes: Heavy but clean. Pause briefly at top.

exercises.name: 7. Backpack Romanian Deadlift
exercises.notes: Increase load if available. Hips back, spine neutral.

exercises.name: 8. Weighted Sit-Up
exercises.notes: Use more resistance than prior weeks if able.

exercises.name: 9. Towel Grip Hold
exercises.notes: Grip a towel hard and hold tension. Good for forearms and boxing robustness.

exercises.name: 10. Tempo Shadowboxing Intervals
exercises.notes: Sharp but submax pace. Focus on rhythm, breathing, and relaxed hands.

exercises.name: 1. Jump Rope
exercises.notes: Easy pulse raiser. Keep it light for deload week.

exercises.name: 2. Dynamic Mobility Circuit
exercises.notes: Move smoothly and do not force range of motion.

exercises.name: 3. Countermovement Jump
exercises.notes: Fast and crisp. Stop before jump height drops.

exercises.name: 4. Push-Up
exercises.notes: Deload volume. Keep reps clean and easy.

exercises.name: 5. Bulgarian Split Squat
exercises.notes: Use lighter load than week 3. Smooth, controlled reps.

exercises.name: 6. 1-Arm Backpack Row
exercises.notes: Moderate effort only. Focus on position and squeeze.

exercises.name: 7. Backpack Romanian Deadlift
exercises.notes: Easy hinge practice. No grinding.

exercises.name: 8. Weighted Sit-Up
exercises.notes: Use a lighter load and leave several reps in reserve.

exercises.name: 9. Front Plank
exercises.notes: Short, strong holds. Quality over duration.

exercises.name: 10. Zone 2 Shadowboxing or Brisk Walk
exercises.notes: Keep it easy and restorative.
